parent_evidence: U5.R2S0 analytic palette-score diffeomorphic oracle full pass
hypothesis: a canonical colour histogram can support hard retrieval of a nearby palette-score case without spatial/content shortcuts, preserving more reference-specific explicit-operator structure than a global average or dense case blend
epistemic_scope: synthetic development only; no confirmatory, photograph, film, stock, preference or operator-identification claim

observations.canonicalization: normalized lexicographic RGB histogram counts only

eligibility: exact permutation histogram and operator error equals zero
all generated coefficients are finite and vector norms do not exceed 2
all sampled outputs remain inside the RGB cube
all sampled Jacobian determinants are positive

allowed_actions: implement deterministic synthetic mixture generation and canonical histograms
implement the fixed retrieval, KDE and averaging controls
run only case-bank and development seeds
freeze exactly one primary method and confirmatory gates in a new committed contract
forbidden_actions: generate or inspect reserved seed 27012 before the confirmatory contract is committed
use any project image or film pixel
add scene, texture, geometry, semantic or spatial features
change the candidate list or generator after development results
claim a palette density is a film-stock transform

branches.eligible_primary_found: freeze one method, thresholds and untouched seed 27012 in a separate S1C confirmatory contract
branches.only_global_or_blend_competitive: close hard case retrieval as averaging or non-distinct under this observation model
branches.query_kde_wins_materially: retain the simpler nonlearned density estimator and close retrieval unless retrieval has an independent diversity advantage
branches.no_eligible_method: close canonical histogram recovery without adding neural capacity

claim_ceiling: development evidence about synthetic canonical-histogram recovery of analytic palette-score flows; never confirmatory, photograph, film, stock, preference, calibrated, production or unpaired-operator evidence
